Adolion: Crimsonwing & Ebonwing
Author view
Overview
Memory
⚑
Where you are
What Waits in the Great Hall
The Great Hall's doors swing open on a throne, an altar with a captive strapped to it, and a cultist still holding the knife.
The scene is tense.
About this story
Your C-rank party is back at the Aegis City Adventurers Guild, and the counter is offering work above your rank: a joint posting with one of the Guild's two famous high-rank parties, Crimsonwing or Ebonwing, to clear a border fort in the Velniran foothills where a rogue lord is buying captives. Expect a hard, dark delve beside partners who are polite, ruthless and proud of their record. Play the Nightriver heir who leads the party, with Belle and Dalan at your side.
Recently
You left Scouting Carrow Keep behind and moved into What Waits in the Great Hall.
Ced prepared a plan to infiltrate Carrow Keep and rescue captives, but Max Nightriver urged caution, so the group held on the ridge to observe patrols. Dalan scouted the west wall and reported a twenty-heartbeat gap in the watch change, and the group entered over the wall at Ced's signal. Inside the Great Hall, they found fresh food on the banquet table, and Ced sensed something was wrong.
Open threads
The Great Hall's fresh banquet and single chair facing the door remain unexplained, and the party must find the captives and the altar without touching the food.
Runo has been tasked to scan for life signs and arcane signatures, and Dalan to check the hall's perimeter for traps or ambushes.
The story so far
Max Nightriver's party chose Ced of Crimsonwing over Kela of Ebonwing for a joint Guild posting to a fort in the Velniran foothills that had been taking captives, resolving the standoff between the two rival leaders in Crimsonwing's favor. The party departed Aegis City's north gate with Ced and Runo of Crimsonwing, hauling a mule of alchemical supplies and a covered cart of Runo's magitech golems. Over four days of disciplined march, Runo confessed to Max that the failed last expedition was his fault and that he had failed the last member of Crimsonwing.

Max Nightriver, Crimsonwing, Ced, Runo, and Dalan reached the ridge overlooking Carrow Keep at dusk, where a violet light pulsed from the chapel tower. Max urged caution, so Ced halted the plan and had the party observe the walls; Runo noticed the guards stood silently and never spoke, while Dalan scouted a lower ledge and timed the watch change at roughly twenty heartbeats with a blind window on the west wall. Dalan set a rope on the west wall, and on Ced's word the party climbed over at the change of watch, crossed the yard behind the patrol, and pushed open the Great Hall's doors. Inside, the violet light pulsed through high windows, a single chair faced the door, and a banquet table held fresh food and drink untouched by the smell of decay; Ced froze and whispered that something was wrong.
